values.ARCHITECTURE_DRIVERS: DOCUMENTATION GAP: identify approved quality attributes, compatibility constraints, and operational drivers.
values.ARCHITECTURE_GAPS: - Decision owner required: architecture has not been formally documented.
values.ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW: DOCUMENTATION GAP: derive the architecture only from verified source entrypoints and authority documents.
values.ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY: No verified architecture summary yet; preserve observed dependency direction and obtain owner approval before changing a boundary.
values.AUTHORITY_DOCUMENTS:
1. `README.md` for confirmed project purpose.
2. DOCUMENTATION GAP: product, architecture, and coding authorities require owner confirmation.
values.BUILD_COMMANDS: No verified build command. Documentation gap: confirm from repository configuration or CI.
values.CODING_STANDARD_CONFLICTS: No target-specific conflict can be evaluated in the example context. Documentation gap: compare selected profiles with repository formatters, linters, compilers, CI, public contracts, and local conventions.
values.CODING_STANDARD_GAPS: - Confirm language/framework standards and their enforcement configuration with project owners.
values.COMMAND_PROVENANCE:
| Command | Evidence | Scope | Mutates state |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| None confirmed | Documentation gap | Unknown | Unknown |
values.CONTEXT_BUDGETS: Initial discovery: at most 8 files, 64 KiB, and 2 evidence-driven expansion rounds.
values.CONTEXT_EXCLUSIONS: Exclude VCS metadata, dependency caches, generated binaries, secrets, credentials, dumps, and large media unless explicitly required and approved.
values.CONTEXT_GAPS: - Confirm module-specific context routes after repository discovery.
values.CONTEXT_ROUTING_NOTES: Start from the approved task, repository authority files, and the mapped module entrypoints. Expand only when a named condition is met.
values.CROSS_CUTTING_CONCERNS: DOCUMENTATION GAP: verify error, concurrency, observability, security/privacy, persistence, configuration, and resource rules.
values.DATA_AND_CONTROL_FLOW: DOCUMENTATION GAP: trace verified entrypoints, data owners, side effects, and downstream consumers.
values.DEPENDENCY_DIRECTION: DOCUMENTATION GAP: record only dependencies observed in source/build configuration and approved by maintainers.
values.ENFORCEMENT_SOURCES: DOCUMENTATION GAP: locate formatter, linter, type/static-analysis, test, generated-code, and CI configuration.
values.ERROR_CONCURRENCY_RESOURCE_RULES: DOCUMENTATION GAP: confirm project-specific error, cancellation, concurrency, lifecycle, and resource ownership rules.
values.LANGUAGE_AND_FRAMEWORK_RULES: DOCUMENTATION GAP: run the read-only language selector against the target, load only its selected reviewed profiles, and add framework-specific rules from verified target evidence.
values.LANGUAGE_PROFILE_SELECTION:
| Language/profile | Detection evidence | Primary authority | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| None selected in example | No target repository evidence supplied | Run the bundled selector | Documentation gap |
values.MODULE_GAPS: - Confirm module owners, public contracts, consumers, and prohibited dependency edges.
values.MODULE_INVENTORY:
| Module/path | Responsibility | Public entrypoints | Dependencies | Consumers | Tests | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Documentation gap | Requires repository discovery | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Unknown | Unassigned |
values.NAMING_AND_API_RULES: DOCUMENTATION GAP: confirm naming, visibility, compatibility, and API documentation rules.
values.PERFORMANCE_BASELINE: No measured repository baseline yet. Record selected file count, selected bytes, discovery rounds, and verification command count before tuning.
values.PERFORMANCE_GAPS: - Replace byte-count proxies with measured model token usage only when the runtime exposes reproducible telemetry.
values.PROHIBITED_DEPENDENCIES: DOCUMENTATION GAP: no prohibited edges may be asserted until architecture evidence and owner approval exist.

expand_when: A referenced caller, consumer, contract, or verification source is outside the initial pack.

documentation_gaps: Confirm source and test module boundaries from repository evidence.

modules.responsibility: Repository-wide AI workflow, architecture documentation, and verification guidance.

values.PUBLIC_CONTRACTS: DOCUMENTATION GAP: inventory exported APIs, wire formats, events, schemas, persisted data, configuration keys, and external behavior.
values.QUALITY_GUARDRAILS: Do not trade correctness, security, compatibility, required tests, or approval boundaries for fewer files, fewer bytes, or faster execution.
values.REPOSITORY_MAP:
- `README.md`: confirmed project overview.
- DOCUMENTATION GAP: source, test, generated, configuration, and deployment paths require discovery.
values.STATIC_CHECK_COMMANDS: No verified format, lint, or static-analysis command. Documentation gap: confirm from repository configuration or CI.
values.SYSTEM_BOUNDARY: DOCUMENTATION GAP: identify in-scope components, external systems, data stores, and trust boundaries.
values.TEST_AND_DOCUMENTATION_RULES: DOCUMENTATION GAP: confirm test levels, naming, fixtures, coverage expectations, and public documentation requirements.
values.TEST_COMMANDS: No verified test command. Documentation gap: confirm from repository configuration or CI.
values.VALIDATION_MATRIX:
| Change type | Focused check | Suite/build | Consumer/contract | Manual |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Documentation only | Link/structure validation | Not applicable unless configured | Not applicable | Review rendered output |
values.VERIFICATION_COMMANDS: No project-specific command confirmed. Use only commands evidenced by repository configuration or CI.

documentation_gaps: Confirm project build, test, format, lint, and static-analysis commands.

escalate_when: A changed contract has consumers outside the approved scope.
